args.title: checkout-api health check failures on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks following the latest production deploy of v2.3.1. At detection, all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were on v2.3.1 with healthy=false and an error rate of 0.18 (18%).

Action taken: Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release previously verified healthy in production (deployment history: v2.2.9 healthy, v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy). The rollback was a known-healthy version, so no change-manager approval was required under the platform runbook.

The first rollback attempt returned a partial failure ("Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error"); us-east moved to v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1. A retry completed successfully.

Current state: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate 0.002 (0.2%).

Follow-ups: Determine root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures before any redeploy (note v2.3.1-rc also shows unhealthy in staging). Investigate the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollback on the first attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis**
- `checkout-api` was on **v2.3.1** in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), reporting `healthy: false` with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed v2.2.9 (healthy), v2.3.0 (healthy), then v2.3.1 (unhealthy). Note v2.3.1-rc is a **staging** entry and also unhealthy, so it was correctly excluded from consideration.

**Rollback**
- Targeted **v2.3.0** — the most recent release verified healthy in production. Since this is a previously-healthy version, no change-manager approval was needed.
- The first attempt returned a **partial failure**: `Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error`. us-east moved to v2.3.0 while us-west and eu-west stayed on the bad v2.3.1.
- I re-checked state, retried the rollback, and it completed across all regions.
- Verified final state: all three regions on v2.3.0, `healthy: true`, error rate down to **0.2%** (from 18%).

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001**, SEV2 for checkout-api, documenting the failure, the rollback (including the partial-failure and retry), the verified post-rollback state, and two follow-ups: root-causing v2.3.1 before any redeploy, and investigating the orchestrator error that caused the halted rollout.
- The create call returned a timeout, so I listed incidents to confirm rather than blindly retrying — the incident did in fact get created, so no duplicate was made.

One thing worth flagging: the rollback orchestrator error is a real reliability concern independent of this bad deploy — a single retry fixed it, but a halted rollout during an incident leaves regions split across versions in the meantime. That's captured in the incident follow-ups.
